runtime: App-owned ordinary installed Chrome with a dedicated Qantas profile. No airline account, personal browser state, subscription, request replay or security modification.
hypothesis: The normal public Rewards booking flow may provide live inventory independently of the cached Flight Reward Finder.
normalFlow: Select Rewards and One way; choose actual airport suggestions.
Choose a departure date in the real calendar; dismiss the About reward seats information dialog normally.
Set the adult count with the actual passenger controls and verify the settled form.
Search flights; accept the explicit Australian-country/AUD continuation notice.
Read the browser-generated native flight response. Clear cabin filters and expand Show more flights.

inventoryResponse.freshness: native response to the actual search

queries.validation: Source list and expanded row count agree. The one-adult sample is covered by the parser fixture; every one-adult fare was not independently reconciled in the browser.

lessons: The global isAward flag is false even while Rewards is selected and Classic awards are returned; validate displayRewardsOnly and each actual marginal reward family.
Commercial fares also contain converted points; these are not Classic awards.
Only flexPricerAvailabilityActionFromLoad is the flight response. Later flexPricerCalendarActionFromLoad responses can overwrite an overly broad capture with a one-item calendar skeleton.

Domestic results use grouped fare buttons; international results use per-family radio cards. Unavailable radio controls may not have disabled=true; inspect the No seats label and actual priced recommendations.
An international Economy search already contains other cabin offers; selecting All reveals the complete returned fare set.
Nearby airport alternatives must be accounted for explicitly. Location keys such as SYD3 are terminal identifiers; resolve the supplied locationCode.
Times are airport-local clocks stored as epoch-shaped values. QF11 arrives earlier on the local clock after crossing the date line.
Cabin maps identify mixed and higher-cabin segments; do not flatten the entire itinerary to the marketed fare cabin.
Change search restored the original Oct5 date after selecting Oct6 on the result calendar. Recheck the actual form; clear an existing airport selection before replacing it.

parser.strips: Session, booking, account, contact and authentication metadata

bookingBoundary: Domestic fare expansion explicitly says log in to select. International radio selection became checked but the cart remained zero; no final cart total, booking or login was completed. Exact party totals above are native response values, not a confirmed booking.
